items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 6 acceptance criteria implemented and confirmed by spec-reviewer PASS; no extra scope beyond the spec.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No API routes touched. The one untrusted boundary (Claude's own JSONL transcript text) is handled defensively: regex extraction returns null on no match, notification correlation no-ops when no card matches, and the task-notification parse cap prevents a pathological input from running unbounded regex work.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No SQL, no auth routes, no secrets. Report text renders through the existing MarkdownChunk/react-markdown sanitized path, same as every other transcript-derived field in this feed.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New/extended tests assert on real outcomes — rendered DOM text, callback arguments, resolved card fields — not internal state. Every new branch has a happy-path and at least one failure/edge-path test (failed status, unmatched taskId, ack with no agentId, a same-id collision).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No DB calls, no unbounded lists. The reducer still runs once per transcript poll, same cost shape as before; the widened task-notification parse cap (4KB->64KB) bounds a single regex pass, not a loop.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Every touched/created file is at or under the 300-line convention ceiling (verified via the anti-ratchet bloat gate, exit 0); the one grandfathered exception's growth (session-parser.ts) is documented with a note field. New files follow existing sibling patterns (missionActivityFeedSubrunner.ts alongside missionActivityFeedClassify.ts/missionActivityFeedTurn.ts; SubrunnerPanel.tsx alongside ArtifactPanel.tsx/MissionArtifactPanel.tsx).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: One changed serialized format: Claude Code CLI's own <task-notification> transcript envelope (producer) is read by session-parser.ts's extractTaskNotification + missionActivityFeedSubrunner.ts (consumer) — read-only per CLAUDE.md rule 1 (webui never writes into Claude's JSONL). Not a round-trip in the write-then-read sense since webui never authors this format; tests instead parse real-shaped JSONL fixtures (dispatch -> ack -> notification) end-to-end through the real parser and reducer, confirmed against an actual captured transcript during build.
